skin_analysis.environment_text: Weather in Shah Alam: 32 °C, 78% humidity, UV index 10 (very high).

advice: The UV index is 10: apply sunscreen every morning and reapply every 2 hours outdoors.
Hot, humid weather: choose light gel or lotion textures and cleanse gently twice a day.
Acne: avoid picking, change pillowcases often, and give a new routine 6–8 weeks.
Oily areas still need moisturizer: skipping it can increase oil production.
